cards.title: CSS styles your page
cards.body: CSS sets how things look. Put it in a `<style>` tag. A rule names what to style, then sets properties inside `{ }`.

cards.title: property: value;
cards.body: Each line inside the braces is `property: value;`. Don't forget the colon and the semicolon.
cards.code: Loud heading

check.question: Which rule makes paragraphs red?
check.explanation: A CSS rule is a selector, then `property: value;` inside curly braces.

exercise.prompt: Add a `<style>` tag and make the `<h1>` orange with the `color` property.
